name: All Star Bulk Order Block
description: All Star Embroidery Gutenberg bulk-order workflow with WooCommerce and ASE Supplier Sync compatibility.
changelog:
1.1.10

  • Impeccable-style visual polish for the customer Artwork section and WooCommerce Artwork Review panel.
  • Merges All Star navy, muted warm gold, white, and quiet neutrals with cleaner hierarchy and fewer nested cards.
  • Improves file rows, timelines, status presentation, focus states, action hierarchy, and responsive stacking.
